versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automates finding and executing cross-chain arbitrage opportunities.

- Scans prices for tokens across 11 chains and identifies profitable arbitrage after accounting for all costs (gas, bridge fees, slippage).
- Includes thorough risk assessment before any execution, vetoing unsafe opportunities.
- Supports full execution and scan-only (research) modes.
- Executes arbitrage via ERC-7683 for secure cross-chain settlement.
- Flexible parameterization: tokens, chains, profit thresholds, amounts, risk tolerance, and mode.
